news.headline: Tighter export rules for advanced AI chips
news.summary: New rules limit sales of the most advanced processors to several countries from January. Chip makers fell; analysts expect a modest hit to 2027 data-center revenue.
news.house: The CIO moved technology from overweight to neutral on 20 October, citing crowded positioning and this policy risk. Research keeps a Buy on NVDA but cut its 2027 estimate 4%.
news.todo: Review single-stock exposure to chip makers, including through funds.

news.headline: CIO moves US large-cap growth to underweight, international to overweight
news.summary: The quarterly allocation update trims large-cap growth by 2 points and adds to large-cap value and international developed stocks.
news.house: Growth leadership is narrow and expensive; earnings are broadening. Portfolios heavy in large-cap growth now sit further from the tactical target.
news.todo: Check households overweight large-cap growth against the new tactical target.

news.headline: Treasury yields jump after strong jobs report
news.summary: The 10-year yield rose 0.25 points to 4.6% as payrolls beat expectations and rate-cut hopes faded. Bond prices fell.
news.house: The CIO keeps bond duration near the benchmark and prefers high-quality corporate and municipal bonds; higher yields improve future income.
news.todo: Explain the bond moves to income-focused clients; no change in allocation needed.

news.headline: Oil falls 7% on supply outlook
news.summary: Producers signalled higher output into 2027. Energy shares fell across the board.
news.house: The CIO moved energy to underweight on 14 October. Research keeps a Neutral on CVX.
news.todo: Note energy exposure in dividend-heavy portfolios.

news.headline: Research cuts CVS to Neutral
news.summary: Cost trends in its insurance business are running above guidance; the team moves to the sidelines until next year's bids are known.
news.house: The CIO stays overweight health care but selective within managed care. Similar companies with Buy ratings include CI and JNJ.
news.todo: Where a manager runs the holding, ask the manager for its view; otherwise review alternatives.

news.headline: Research cuts PFE to Neutral after trial misses
news.summary: Two late-stage readouts missed; the dividend looks covered but 2027 estimates come down about 8%.
news.house: Health care remains an overweight for the CIO. Research prefers JNJ and MRK in pharmaceuticals.
news.todo: Review PFE holders; for manager-run sleeves, raise it with the manager.

news.headline: Large-cap tech rallies on strong cloud earnings
news.summary: Software and device makers rose after cloud revenue beat estimates.
news.house: Strong results, but the CIO is neutral on technology after its run; gains are a chance to trim concentrated positions.
news.todo: Use the rally to revisit concentrated technology positions.

news.headline: Kaplan asks whether to sell AAPL before retiring
news.summary: Client email: "Should I sell my Apple shares now or wait until I retire? I don't want a huge tax bill."
news.house: Research rates AAPL Buy; the CIO is neutral on technology. AAPL is 28.9% of the account, well above the 10% guideline.
news.todo: Build a multi-year sale plan that respects trading windows and the retirement income need.

news.headline: Research cuts TSLA to Underperform
news.summary: Delivery growth is slowing into 2027 while the valuation still assumes autonomy revenue the team now expects later.
news.house: No CIO change. Exposure among your households is only through broad index funds.
news.todo: No action for these households; monitor.

intel.headline: Research upgrades JPM to Buy
intel.abstract: Net interest income is holding up better than expected and capital return is rising; the team raises its 2027 estimate 5%.

intel.headline: CIO moves high-yield bonds from neutral to overweight
intel.abstract: Default expectations have eased and yields remain above their 10-year average; the CIO adds 1 point to high yield within fixed income.

intel.headline: European banks: sector upgraded to Overweight
intel.abstract: Higher-for-longer rates and buybacks support earnings; the team prefers large lenders in France and Spain.

intel.headline: Yen jumps 3% after the central bank signals higher rates
intel.abstract: A stronger yen weighs on Japanese exporters in local terms but lifts the dollar value of unhedged Japanese holdings.

intel.headline: CIO keeps energy at neutral
intel.abstract: Supply discipline supports prices; the CIO holds energy at neutral.
intel.superseded_by: CIO moved energy to underweight on 14 October
